goal: Get the README's 'Quick start with diffusers' LineArt example working on this CPU-only machine (no GPU): StableDiffusionXLAdapterPipeline with the TencentARC/t2i-adapter-lineart-sdxl-1.0 adapter, stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0, the madebyollin/sdxl-vae-fp16-fix VAE and the EulerAncestral scheduler, with the models downloaded from Hugging Face.
